no24-10aug1807.summary: George W. Erving reports to Madison that Godoy paid for the Hanover bargain out of his own funds and, Hanover going to Westphalia with the peace, believes he has been deceived; a Kingdom of Ebro is projected and the invasion of Portugal is renewed with a view to conquest, while Godoy's counter-project is a separate peace with England through Russian mediation. The postscript of the 11th has Spain sending an army into Portugal and Godoy seeing no course but to submit.
